title: Bookkeeping
notSetUp: Accounts are missing before the stock value can be booked.
notStarted: Booking of the stock value is not turned on yet.
uncertain: The voucher for {date} was sent by {name} but Fortnox never gave a clear answer. Nothing more can be booked until it is settled.
resolvedFound: The voucher was in Fortnox as {label}
resolvedReleased: The voucher was not in Fortnox. What was on it is waiting again.
nothingDue: Nothing is waiting. Every movement of the stock is booked.
correctionsHint: What has changed on days that are already booked. Booked in a voucher of its own, dated today.
missingAccount: An account is missing for this row. Choose it in the settings.
undoMessage: Only do this if the voucher has been voided in Fortnox. The app forgets that it was sent, and what it carried is booked again in the next voucher.

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.hint: The stock accounts according to the stock compared with the ledger, last fetched {at}.
recon.neverSynced: The ledger has not been fetched from Fortnox yet, so there is nothing to compare with.
recon.stale: A voucher has been sent since the ledger was fetched. Sync with Fortnox before booking the difference.
recon.confirmMessage: A voucher dated {date} brings the stock accounts in Fortnox to the stock's value. The difference is booked against the stocktake difference account.

through.hint: Everything not yet booked up to and including the date becomes one voucher, dated that day. What comes after waits for next time.

refused.alreadySent: The stock is already booked through {date}. Pick a later date.
refused.closedPeriod: Fortnox has no open financial year for {date}.
refused.nothingToSend: There is nothing to book through {date}.
